Lawn Care Questions

Can you cut my grass on a regular schedule?

Yes. We can come by regularly through the season, or just once when you need it. Tell us how often and we'll plan around it.

Do you do spring and fall cleanups?

Yes — raking, bagging leaves and clippings, and tidying beds and edges so your yard is ready for the season ahead.

Can you plant trees or shrubs?

Yes. We've planted fruit trees for customers around Sudbury — you can see one of those jobs above. Tell us what you'd like planted and where.

How do I get an estimate?

Fill out the form below, call or WhatsApp 705-562-9047, or email sudburyworkforce@gmail.com. Estimates are free, with no obligation.

Do you cover my area?

We look after lawns all over Greater Sudbury, from Lively and Walden to Hanmer, Val Caron and Garson. See all the areas we serve.
